payload.name: PreserveAllActivityComponents
payload.description: When extracting an activity that covers multiple distinct areas or topics, ensure every area is kept as an equal component in the memory content.
content: During extraction, when a memory subject performs an activity (seminar, class, program, campaign, etc.) covering multiple distinct areas or topics, represent each area as an equal component in the memory content (e.g., 'seminars on X and Y'), not as a modifier of the first area.

Before creating an ADD/UPDATE candidate, scan the source for all explicitly listed areas linked by 'and', 'as well as', or 'plus'; confirm each appears in the candidate's content and object fields; if any is missing, revise the candidate.

solves: When a source describes one activity spanning multiple distinct areas (e.g., seminars on sports and marketing), extraction may treat the first area as the activity type and demote others, losing a fact. This skill requires storing all listed areas as equal components. It applies to any activity with a conjunctive list in future sessions, and does not apply when only one area is truly named.
